description: This PHP source file defines the `AttendancePunchOutRecordOverlapAPI` class, which extends functionality related to checking overlap records for punch-out attendance events within an HR management system. It includes an API endpoint method `getOne()` for verifying punch-out overlaps, utilizing request parameters and attendance service methods.

classes.name: AttendancePunchOutRecordOverlapAPI
classes.description: API class providing endpoint to check for punch-out record overlaps in attendance system and extending the overlap checking functionality for punch-in records.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET request to check for punch-out overlaps for an employee at a specific date and time, returning a result indicating whether an overlap exists.
